title: EngineStatus
description: Where the engine is in the match it is following.

state.title: EngineState
state.description: `waiting` for a match; `rebuilding` state from events that already happened (after a seek or a mid-match connect); `live`, following the broadcast as it happens; `playing` behind live, at the viewer's speed; `paused`; or the viewer has reached the end of the match (`ended`).

generation.description: The generation of the last MatchReset.

teams.description: The teams seen so far, in order of first appearance.

score.description: The score as of the latest event processed, in the order of teams.

period.description: Period of the latest event processed: where the viewer is.

match_clock_s.description: Game clock of the latest event processed.

period_over.description: Whether the period of the latest event has ended (half-time, full time, or the end of a period of extra time): the clock stands still until the next one kicks off. Between events it otherwise runs on.

play_s.description: Seconds of play so far, continuous across periods.

speed.description: The viewer's playback speed while behind live.

live_edge.title: LiveEdge
live_edge.description: The latest point of the broadcast received so far: the viewer can seek up to here.

play_s.description: Seconds of play up to the live edge, continuous across periods.

behind_live_s.description: Seconds of play between the viewer and the live edge.

rebuilding_to.description: While `rebuilding`: the offset where live play resumes.

late_dropped.description: Events dropped for arriving too late to reorder.
